Title: Azure portal to end support for Internet Explorer 11 on March 31, 2021

Body.Content:
Beginning March 31, 2021, the Azure Portal web app will no longer support IE 11. This means starting March 31, 2021, customers will be unable to access the Azure Portal via IE 11.

The recommended browser for the Azure Portal is the new Microsoft Edge, which follows the Modern Policy. Go here to download

Note: Internet Explorer continues to be supported by Microsoft as a component of the Windows operating system and follows the Lifecycle Policy for the product on which it is installed. Using Internet Explorer mode in the new Microsoft Edge will not extend IE 11 access to the Azure Portal beyond the date listed above.
